latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor Not Generator — Edit and Export Existing Videos.

- Quickly edit existing video files by describing your desired changes in plain language.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more).
- Automatic cloud-based editing; no software setup required.
- Simple onboarding: connects to backend and manages session/token for you.
- Export clean, edited video clips (default 1080p MP4) in 1–2 minutes.
- Ideal for creators and marketers who want fast results without learning complex editors.
